_comment: SSOT for scripts/validate-harness.py:check_core_workflow_contract. Declares which packages/targets/*/config.json distribute entries are required for the Core Workflow (change.json / harnessctl.py) to function for that target, so the check can iterate data instead of hardcoding target names.

destinationOverrides._comment: Per-target override of the requiredDistribution destination key (e.g. opencode reads policy/workflows from a runtime/ prefix instead of configDir root).

gateDistribution._comment: target -> {destination, source} for the Core Workflow enforcement gate (hooks/plugins/extensions) that must be distributed to that target.
